system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: a prompt-cache-stable context that compacts to each model's real window
system_prompt_style.note: SystemPromptService.swift exists and the system prompt is user-editable in Settings; the assembly mechanism is not visible in the evidence. The value is inferred from runtime tool filtering and the goal/memory features.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It indexes entire codebases into a portable JSONL repo-map that any LLM can consume.
env_context_strategy.note: The file tool offers read/list/search/read_dir. It is unclear whether the repo-map is injected by default; if it is, the value would be mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tiered: Tier 1 = on-device Apple Intelligence summarization (free, private, no API tokens). Tier 2 = aggressive prune if Apple AI unavailable.
context_compaction.note: Full tool results are spilled to disk and can be recovered with restore_tool_result.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Take screenshots or paste images. Vision-capable AI models analyze what they see
observation_format.note: The accessibility tool returns element trees, but the format sent to the model is not shown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: tool calls are reassembled and dispatched to Agent!'s tool runner

tool_count.evidence_quote: These are the canonical tool names defined in `AgentTools.Name.*` and exposed to every LLM provider via `AgentTools.tools(for:)`.
tool_count.note: The count of 27 comes from the README tables and excludes MCP tools. Per-provider toggles can reduce it.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit` = single-string replace. `diff_apply` = preferred for multi-line code edits
edit_primitive.note: The file tool also has write/create actions and AST-like refactors (extract_function, if_to_switch).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP tools are appended at runtime as `mcp_<server>_<tool>`
tool_schema_source.note: The hand_written value for built-in tools is assumed; the schema source is not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Agent! supports [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) servers for extended capabilities.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Built-in autonomous task loop that reasons, executes, and self-corrects.
loop_primitives.note: Default loop is react. event_driven is based on the claim that event hooks are wired; generate_test_repair is based on the opt-in critic.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Multi-plan CRUD with per-step status tracking

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only).
multi_agent_topology.note: The spawn_agent tool is listed among the tools; whether it is on by default is not confirmed.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only). Optional model override + file-based results
delegation_mechanism.note: There is also a tell_agent mailbox for messaging sub-agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Mid-task user dialog (waits up to 5 min)
human_in_loop.note: Evidence is ask_user plus one-time daemon approval; this is not per-call approval. Closest value chosen.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Persistent goal + success criteria; marking done requires evidence

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Open `~/Documents/AgentScript/memory.md` in the system default editor
long_term_memory.note: The skill tool provides reusable prompt templates.

state_persistence.note: SessionStore.swift exists, but resume behaviour is not shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: an opt-in critic reviews the diff before completion
self_verification.note: The critic is opt-in. Auto-verify is a coding preference; the goal_state evidence gate is enforced by default.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Agent! auto-switches to the next provider in the user-configured chain after 2 failures.
retry_policy.note: This is provider failover, not a task-level retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Signal task complete. Required at end of every task
termination_condition.note: Max iterations is set in Agent Options. stall_detection is inferred from StuckGuard.swift.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Anthropic `cache_control` ephemeral + automatic prefix-cache hit tracking
cost_controls.note: model_routing reflects per-sub-agent model overrides. The fallback chain is failover and is not counted.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Mid-task user dialog (waits up to 5 min)

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Shell as current user via Launch Agent. Primary shell tool

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Shell as ROOT via Launch Daemon. Admin tasks only — no sudo

network_policy.evidence_quote: Fetch URL, strip HTML, cap 8K chars

permission_model.evidence_quote: Hard-blocks catastrophic commands (`rm -rf /`, `rm -rf ~`, `dd` to `/dev/disk`, fork bombs, `--no-preserve-root`) before the Process is even constructed.

tracing.evidence_quote: Agent! shows everything it does and logs every action.

replayability.note: The only replay-related item is the test file AgentTests/LoopReplayTests.swift.

eval_hooks.note: No benchmark runner appears in the file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Only approved senders can run tasks. Unapproved messages are logged but ignored.
guardrails.note: action_policies is based on the Shell Safety Service blocklist.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Supports automation, scripting, coding, build anything and more.

open_source.evidence_quote: The source code of "🦾 Agent! for macOS26" is open source and licensed under the **MIT License**.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Powered by 21 LLM providers across local and cloud platforms.
